sentences.en: He reiterated this advice several more times during the meeting.
sentences.zh: 他在会议中多次重申了这一建议。

sentences.en: You just reiterate stupidity what you can hear in the media.
sentences.zh: 你只是在重复媒体上听到的愚蠢言论。

sentences.en: The press office later reiterated the point.
sentences.zh: 公关部门后来再次强调了这一点。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：re（一再）+iter（重说）+ate（做）→反复地说
